The first thing to do is to confirm that you're using the correct server settings. This page has their required IMAP./POP/SMTP settings:

https://www.spark.co.nz/help/get-more/xtra/xtra-mail-setup/

The fact that it happens irregularly suggests to me that there may actually be an ongoing problem with their email service. Have you tried contacting them while it's happening to see if there is a known outage?
